maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is charter hire from carrying dry bulk cargoes (iron ore, grain, bauxite) on owned vessels, not servicing installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private multinational charterers and commodity shippers paying for drybulk transport; not government-funded.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by operating and occasionally buying or selling vessels in its fleet of 44 ships, not by regular company acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Drybulk vessel charters are largely commoditized; charterers can switch to other shipowners on rate and vessel availability.
